data.narrative:
Carbon Robotics is a Series C robotics and manufacturing company founded by Paul Mikesell that has raised $177M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private companies and 1 public company operating in the same sector and stage cohort, including peers such as Exotec, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, and Hadrian.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C to subsequent-stage progression against the $177M total raised as a valuation proxy, yielding $301M. Peer-median analysis examines 7 robotics and manufacturing companies at same or adjacent stages; the median valuation across this set is $1.6B, with a range of $1.0B to $2.0B. The peer set includes companies valued at $2.0B (Exotec, Generalist AI), $1.8B (Bedrock Robotics), and $1.6B (Dexterity, Hadrian).

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $256M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $975M. The wide range reflects material uncertainty around whether Carbon Robotics will follow a capital-efficient growth trajectory—consistent with stage-progression methods—or achieve peer-level scale valuations. Revenue traction, unit economics, and market adoption velocity will be critical determinants within this range.
